title: feat(spec,metadata-protocol): the publish receipt names the rows a seed created and the rows it only matched

domain:spec#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzfgvGexKn9vLHsy89K

_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBY35nWXYXKyBvnYcvZDpPht)_


Fixes #30348

Ruling-ref: objectstack-ai/cloud#3598 (6651768430)

Clause-②: yes (widening: an optional, capped per-object `landed` key on both `seedApplied` receipts, and `insertedIds` on the seed loader's per-dataset result)
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: none owed — no skill, eval or doc teaches `seedApplied` or `landedIds` (`git grep -n "seedApplied\|landedIds" -- skills content/docs ':!content/docs/references' ':!content/docs/releases'`: 0 hits; control `git grep -c "publish" -- skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md`: 5); the generated references (`content/docs/references/api/protocol.mdx`, `data/seed-loader.mdx`) are regenerated here. The skills lane is paused; nothing is owed to it from this PR.
Prior rulings read: seedapplied,landedids,publish receipt → 1 hits; ADR-0038 Decision §4; thread: none; repo: objectstack-ai/objectstack

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：两个发布接口的回执 `seedApplied` 新增可选字段 `landed`，按对象分两张 id 列表：`inserted`（本次发布新建的行）和 `matched`（种子按自然键匹配到的已有行），每张最多 200 个 id，超出时 `truncated: true` 并给出未截断的 `total`；种子加载器结果新增 `insertedIds`。
- 为什么改：执行 cloud#3598 裁决 A。cloud 的「清理示例数据」需要知道发布写了哪些行，回执原来只给条数。拆成两张表是因为默认 `ignore` 模式下，种子会"落"在键相同的客户已有行上而不写它；只给一张表会让 cloud 删掉客户自己的行。
- 风险与回滚：纯增字段、可选，旧回执原样解析；代价是公开发布响应里出现行 id（受 200 上限约束，裁决已接受）。回滚即还原本 PR。cloud 只能清理 `inserted` 里的行，且要跨多次发布累积，因为再次发布时早先插入的行会出现在 `matched`。
- 先看：`packages/metadata-protocol/src/seed-loader.ts` 的 `insertedRecordIndexes`（两个插入点）；`packages/metadata-protocol/src/seed-applied-landed.ts`（合并、去重、截断）；`packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts` 的 `SeedAppliedLandedSchema` 与上限常量。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/publish-seed-receipt-landed-ids.test.ts`，预期 9 例全绿（含客户已有行只进 `matched`、超限截断、空种子给两张空表、无种子无字段）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`@objectstack/spec` (`packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts`): `seedApplied.landed`, one shared schema on both publish responses.**
  - `SeedAppliedLandedSchema`: `{ object, inserted, matched }`, each list a `SeedAppliedIdListSchema` `{ ids, total, truncated }` with all three required. `ids.max(SEED_APPLIED_LANDED_IDS_CAP)`, in the loader's record order (datasets in load order, records as authored), not the order the writes completed (the loader buffers inserts and flushes them after later skips).
  - `SEED_APPLIED_LANDED_IDS_CAP = 200` (source below).
  - `PublishMetaItemResponseSchema.seedApplied.landed` and `PublishPackageDraftsResponseSchema.seedApplied.landed` both point at it, with one description text. Optional: absent means "not reported", never "nothing landed".
  - The `PublishMetaItemResponseSchema` docblock (the three conditional receipts) names the key, the two lists, the cap, the truncation shape and the accepted cost.
- **`@objectstack/spec` (`packages/spec/src/data/seed-loader.zod.ts`): `SeedLoadResult.insertedIds`**, the ids among `landedIds` whose row the load created. `landedIds`' TSDoc now states what each mode puts in it (below).
- **`@objectstack/metadata-protocol`:**
  - `seed-loader.ts`: the two insert sites (the batched insert flush and the self-referencing sequential `writeRecord` with `action === 'inserted'`) mark the record index beside `noteLanded`; the result carries `insertedIds` in record order, deduped.
  - `seed-applied-landed.ts` (new, exported as `seedAppliedLanded`): folds the loader's per-dataset results into one entry per object, in first-loaded order; ids keep the loader's record order (datasets in load order, records as authored, first occurrence kept), not the order the writes completed. Several datasets of one object merge; ids dedupe; an id any dataset of the object inserted is never also `matched`; each list is capped. An object whose datasets landed nothing still gets an entry with two empty lists.
  - `applySeedBodies` returns `landed: seedAppliedLanded(r.results)` on the path where the loader returned. `publishPackageDrafts` and `publishMetaItem` (through `runPublishSideEffects`) pass it through; their inline return types gain the key.
- **`@objectstack/runtime` (`domains/packages.ts`)**: the route-level fallback apply (`applyPublishedSeeds`, for protocols that do not self-apply) returns the same `landed` through the same exported projection.
- Generated artifacts regenerated: `authorable-surface/{api,data}.json`, `authorable-defaults/data.json`, `json-schema.manifest/api.json`, `api-surface`, `export-origins`, `declaration-map`, the strictness-ledger counts, and `content/docs/references/{api/protocol,data/seed-loader,index}.mdx`.
- `.changeset/30348-seed-receipt-landed-ids.md`: spec minor, metadata-protocol minor, runtime patch.

### What "landed" means, per seed mode (measured at `seed-loader.ts`, every `noteLanded` site)

| Mode | `inserted` | `matched` | Not listed |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `insert` / `replace` | every row an insert created | none | a record whose insert failed |
| `ignore` (default since #30081) | rows created for records no existing row matched | existing rows a record's key matched, left as they were | a failed insert |
| `upsert` | rows created | rows updated, rows matched and left unchanged (no-op replay), rows matched whose update the engine refused | a failed insert |
| `update` | none | rows updated, matched and unchanged, or refused | a record that matched no row |

A dry run lists nothing. A matched row whose update was refused is listed because the loader notes it before the write (the row exists and its key resolved).

**Consequence for cloud (cloud#3598):** only `inserted` names rows the seed created. A `matched` row may be a customer's own record that shares the seed's natural key; under `ignore` it is matched without being written. ⛔ Never clear a `matched` row on this receipt's word. `inserted` is per publish: a row an earlier publish inserted shows as `matched` on a re-publish, so the ledger must accumulate `inserted` ids across publishes rather than read the latest receipt alone.

### The cap and its source

`SEED_APPLIED_LANDED_IDS_CAP = 200` ids per list, per object. The card asked for the cloud ledger's cap on `seeded_record_ids`; objectstack-ai/cloud could not be read from this session (no repository access; an org-wide code search for `seeded_record_ids` returned 0 hits). There is no platform precedent for a bounded id list on a response, so the number follows the platform's existing bounds on a record-id list: `EXPLAIN_BATCH_MAX_RECORD_IDS = 200` (`packages/spec/src/security/explain.zod.ts:257`, the cap on record ids crossing the public API) and the seed loader's 200-row insert batch (`BULK_BATCH_SIZE`). The truncation shape follows `SearchAllResponseSchema.truncated`: declared, never silent. Chosen with spec seat 3 before building. If cloud's ledger cap differs, aligning it is a one-constant change.

**Accepted cost (ruling A):** row ids appear on the public `POST /packages/:id/publish-drafts` and `POST /meta/:type/:name/publish` responses, bounded by the cap.

## Why

AI builds land their sample rows when the seed draft is published. The loader computes which rows it landed on (`landedIds`), but `applySeedBodies` returned only `success`, `inserted` and `updated`, so cloud's "clear sample data" could not find the rows (measured on a hosted kernel at 1a3ea0c0, cloud#3598 report 6650239213). Ruling A puts the ids on the receipt. Splitting them into `inserted` and `matched` is what keeps the clear safe under the create-only default.

Both response schemas parse the real responses.
  - `packages/metadata-protocol/src/seed-applied-landed.test.ts` (9, the projection without an engine): junk entries (null, missing or non-string `object`) skipped; no results give `[]`; a dataset that landed nothing (or predates `insertedIds`) gives two empty lists; one dataset's split; exactly 200 ids carried whole with `truncated: false`, 201 cut to 200 with `total: 201`, `truncated: true`, and each list cut on its own; across datasets of one object a row one inserted and another matched stays `inserted` only, whichever order; objects in first-loaded order and ids deduped, first occurrence kept. Its output parses through `SeedAppliedLandedSchema`.
  - `packages/metadata-protocol/src/seed-loader-landed-ids.test.ts` (+6): `insertedIds` on a fresh load equals `landedIds`; a replay (skip and update) inserts nothing; `ignore` over a pre-existing row; a refused update is landed, not inserted; the self-referencing sequential path; a refused insert and a dry run.
  - `packages/spec/src/api/protocol.test.ts` (+4): both receipts carry `landed`; existing receipts parse unchanged and gain no key; the cap (200 parses, 201 refused); `total`, `truncated` and both lists are required.
- Existing pins updated: `publish-meta-response-conformance.test.ts` (the real seed publish now asserts the `landed` entry) and `publish-package-drafts-seed-receipt-counts.test.ts` (two `toEqual`s on the success receipt admit `landed`).

## Acceptance notes

- A load that THROWS (a seed naming a missing object, a storage outage mid-dataset) reports `inserted`/`updated` counts from `seedLoadPartialWrites` but no ids, so `landed` is absent there. Carrying ids on that path would mean widening `SeedLoadPartialWrites`; not done here, and cloud must read an absent `landed` beside `success: false` as "rows may have landed, ids unknown".
- Contract review (spec seat 3, PASS) should-fix 4, the ids of datasets that landed before a mid-batch throw being dropped with the rest, is the case in the note above; the seat files it as a follow-up, so it stays out of this PR.
- Two producer tests use a mocked `applySeedBodies` (`protocol-publish-package-drafts.test.ts`), so their `toEqual` receipts are unchanged.
